text:
sam_dev: Heads-up — a staging multi-node TP job hung when we scaled from 8->16 ranks. Root shows NCCL/timeouts and a rank desync. Repro steps below and some logs.

jess_infra: ugh, any recent runtime changes? kernel selection or batching tweaks this week?

sam_dev: we rolled kernel-selection v2 on Tuesday (chooses fp16-fused matmul kernels for certain layers). Also applied a batching heuristic tweak that groups by prompt-prefix hash.

mike_ml: can you paste the NCCL logs and any profiler traces? even a tiny nsys capture helps.

sam_dev: pasted minimal excerpts:
```
NCCL INFO THREAD 0 : Channel 0 : Comm 0x7f8e4000 : op allreduce ring : peer 0 -> 1 : 8192 bytes : status 0
...
ncclWaitAll: NET/Error/Timeout  (Host:10.3.12.7:23456)
RuntimeError: ProcessGroupNCCL timeout: rank 7 timed out waiting for 0 -> 1 allreduce
Fatal: inconsistent ranks: expected 16 got 15
```

sam_dev: nsys capture (short): major gaps where GPU compute finishes early but allreduce stalls for 200-400ms. GPU utilization dips to near 0 during that time.

ria_sre: sounds like a comm/compute overlap regression. Did kernel v2 change buffer sizes or alignment? small, misaligned buffers can explode number of allreduce calls.

mike_ml: good call. kernel v2 switched from contiguous fused activation buffer to per-layer allocations to reduce peak memory. That can fragment tensors and change allreduce packetization.

jess_infra: also check KV cache layout: recent KV cache reuse change packs key/vals per-shard instead of per-layer. If rank 7 ended up with slightly different sequence lengths due to a batching heuristic, the comm pattern can diverge -> rank desync.

sam_dev: repro script attached (short run):
```bash
# uses 2 nodes, 8 ranks/node
export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
export NCCL_IB_TIMEOUT=34
export NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1
python -m torch.distributed.run --nproc_per_node=8 --nnodes=2 --node_rank=$RANK run_tp_workload.py --model sharded --use-kv-reuse
```

sam_dev: quick profiling shows many small allreduces (~2-16KB) instead of fewer larger ones. walltime dominated by NCCL setup waits.

ria_sre: immediate mitigations: 1) revert kernel-selection v2 on canary pool, 2) force batching heuristic to prefix-length bucket to avoid inter-rank variance, 3) enable NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING and larger ib timeout while debugging.

mike_ml: longer-term: we should add a TP scaling test that validates allreduce call counts and aggregate bytes across ranks. Also add an invariant check that seq-len distribution per-rank matches expected; fail the job early if mismatch.

jess_infra: can we capture a tiny nccl-tests allreduce microbench between nodes for the same message sizes we see (2-16KB) to measure multi-node latency and see if IB/RDMA is flapping?

sam_dev: ran nccl-tests (mv2 sizes): latency spikes at 8 nodes, 16 ranks/node config shows unexpected 120-300us spikes on some sizes. Attaching raw numbers to the thread (summary): sizes <=16KB median 70us but p95 310us.

mike_ml: that matches the nsys gap. Hypothesis: fragmentation + increased count of allreduces => NCCL protocol switching or queue saturation on the NIC, causing long tail. Kernel v2 reduced compute time so compute no longer hides comm latency -> visible stall.

ria_sre: plan:
- roll back kernel-selection v2 on staging (canary) today (assigned: jess_infra)
- re-run with forced contiguous buffer allocation patch (sam_dev) to validate fragmentation theory
- add a short nccl-tests job to the pre-commit TP gating (mike_ml)
- add a tiny debug hook that dumps per-rank seq-len distribution to logs before rendezvous (sam_dev + jess_infra)

jess_infra: started rollback to kernel-selection v1 on two staging shards now. will report. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: deploy job 3421 started: rollback-kernel-v1 -> staging (2 shards). ETA ~7min.

sam_dev: thanks — i'll kick the repro once rollback is in. also will try forcing contiguous KV allocation locally to see if it fixes microbench.

jess_infra: rollback completed on shard A. initial quick run shows no hang at 16 ranks — runs through profile. Good sign.

mike_ml: excellent. still add the gating and the per-rank invariants. If we had that earlier we would have failed fast.

sam_dev: adding invariant patch to PR now. small change: if stddev(seq_lens) across ranks > 2 and mean > X then abort. Will add logging to help debugging.

ria_sre: once reverted, let's still keep KV-reuse change behind a feature flag and test at lower scale. Also add an automated nsys trace sampler for 10% of big-scale runs.

jess_infra: notes for postmortem: root cause likely buffer fragmentation from kernel-selection v2 combined with batching heuristic + KV cache layout change exposing inter-rank seq-len variance. Symptom: many small allreduces -> NCCL latency tails -> timeouts and rank desync. Action items listed.

sam_dev: thanks everyone. i'll follow up with repro artifact and PR links in this thread when ready.

mike_ml: :thumbsup:

ria_sre: great triage. adding incident label and will schedule a 30m follow-up if needed.

ci-bot: incident created #INC-2026-042: multi-node TP allreduce tail latency (assigned: eng-runtime)
